0: CITY OF MOLENA ORDNANCE NO. 23 TO AMEND SECTION 1 AND SECTION 3 OF ORDNANCE 18 TO IMPOSE LICENSE FEES ON INSURERS CONDUCTING BUSINESS WITHIN THE CITY OF MOLENA.
1: - (23) 1/1 THERE IS HEREBY LEVIED FOR THE YEAR 1997 AND FOR EACH YEAR THEREAFTER AN ANNUAL LICENSE FEE UPON EACH INSURER DOING BUSINESS WITHIN THE CITY OF MOLENA IN THE AMOUNT OF FIFTEEN DOLLARS ($15). FOR EACH SEPARATE BUSINESS LOCATION IN EXCESS OF ONE NOT COVERED BY
2: OF MOLENA, THERE IS HEREBY LEVIED A LICENSE FEE IN THE AMOUNT OF FIFTEEN DOLLARS ($15). FOR THE PURPOSES OF THIS ORDNANCE, THE TERM "INSURER" MEANS A COMPANY WHICH IS AUTHORIZED TO TRANSACT BUSINESS IN THE CLASSES OF INSURANCE DESIGNATED IN 0.C.G.A. 33-3-5.
3: AGENCIES, BROKERS, ETC. NOT OTHERWISE LICENSED. THERE IS HEREBY LEVIED FOR THE YEAR 1997 AND FOR EACH YEAR THEREAFTER AN ANNUAL LICENSE FEE UPON INDEPENDENT AGENCIES AND BROKERS FOR EACH SEPARATE BUSINESS LOCATION FROM WHICH AN INSURANCE BUSINESS IS CONDUCTED AND WHICH IS NOT SUBJECT TO THE COMPANY LICENSE FEE IMPOSED BY SECTION 1 HEREOF, IN THE AMOUNT OF FIFTEEN DOLLARS ($15) FOR EACH LOCATION WITHIN THE CITY OF MOLENA. FIRST READING 3/4/97 SECOND READING 4/1/97 CLERK HELEN S. BECKHAM MAYOR, CITY OF MOLENA
